resolution.rationale: R-023 does not constitute a defensible lexical start. Its text is a composite OCR/layout artifact: two fragments are demonstrable bleed from left-column L-020, while the remaining `apuna` fragment belongs structurally with the neighboring `Colmar` region represented by R-024. Therefore the most conservative candidate-level classification is false_positive rather than article or continuation.
